text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — streaming responses p95/p99 breached in eu-west-1 (SSE). Auto-pages sent to @sre-oncall and @infra-lead. Severity: high. Start investigating now.

sre-oncall: I'm online, looking at the routing plane and proxy pool. Confirming scope: streaming SSE and websocket clients reporting stalls / very delayed chunks.

infra-lead: I'm seeing backlog on proxy workers and a recurring pattern of keepalive resets from the HA proxy layer when client-side RX buffers spike. Logs: `proxy_conn_reset from 10.4.2.*` every ~2s.

eng-oncall: repro steps? any recent deploys?

sre-oncall: no infra deploys in last 30m. App code unchanged. Traffic spike started ~10:01Z. p95 jumped from 1.2s to ~3.7s, p99 from 2.6s to ~8s for streaming endpoints.

infra-lead: pulling nginx/haproxy stats now. `haproxy -c` shows worker queue growth and many connections in "CLOSING" with small outstanding write buffers. Suspect slow consumer/backpressure plus proxies expiring keepalives -> client sockets stuck.

eng-oncall: can we confirm whether KV cache or runtime is stalling? If proxy keeps connections open but not servicing writes, runtime might be fine.

ops-bot: quick command: `kubectl get pods -n redwood-proxy -l app=proxy -o wide` -> 6/6 replicas. CPU low; socket backlog high on 3 nodes.

sre-oncall: temporarily routing burst traffic away from eu-west-1 to eu-central as mitigation? Any downstream customers in eu-west dependent on locality? @customer-ops

customer-ops: 3 enterprise customers with EU routing. For two, cross-region routing will be acceptable for ~30m, one (regulated) cannot cross. We need targeted mitigation for eu-west-only traffic.

infra-lead: immediate mitigation idea: increase proxy keepalive timeout, restart proxy workers rolling on the 3 nodes with high socket backlog, and reduce `sendfile` chunk size to force flush. Will run a canary restart on one node first.

eng-oncall: also enable per-request write timeouts to drop slow consumers earlier (config change). I can roll the config via canary.

sre-oncall: action plan: 1) canary proxy restart on node-a. 2) if stable, rolling restarts node-b/c. 3) short-term config tweak to keepalive -> 120s from 30s. 4) enable write-timeout drop for long-sitting connections.

infra-lead: running canary now on proxy-a: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/proxy -n redwood-proxy --selector=zone=eu-west-a`

sre-oncall: monitoring p95/p99 and live chunk metrics.

(30s later)

infra-lead: canary looks promising — socket backlog cleared on node-a, p95 dropped to ~1.5s, p99 down to ~3.2s.

eng-oncall: proceeding to apply write-timeout flag and keepalive bump in configmap, will roll with 1% canary traffic first. Config snippet: 
```
proxy:
  keepalive_timeout: 120s
  write_timeout: 20s
  sendfile_chunk: 64k
```

ops-bot: running `kubectl apply -f proxy-configmap.yaml -n redwood-proxy` and initiating rolling restart with maxUnavailable=1.

sre-oncall: updating incident status: impacted customers: 3 (2 can tolerate cross-region; 1 regulated). Customer-ops is contacting regulated customer with ETA for targeted fix.

customer-ops: messaging draft ready: "We observed elevated streaming latency in eu-west starting 10:01Z, mitigation in progress. We may reroute traffic or apply config changes; we'll update in 15m."

product-manager: need to know if any SLOs will be breached for >30m window. Current estimate: p99 improved but not back to baseline; we might be in SLO alert territory for the regulated customer.

sre-oncall: tracking SLO impact in ops dashboard. Setting mitigated=false until all nodes stable and regulated customer confirmed.

(15m later)

infra-lead: rolling restart complete across eu-west proxies. All backends report healthy. p95 1.1s, p99 2.4s — near baseline. No increases in runtime CPU/queue.

eng-oncall: runtime traces show normal token generation timing; the issue correlated with proxy socket handling and client backpressure. No evidence of model/eval regressions.

customer-ops: regulated customer confirmed they see reduced stalls and acceptable latency. They will keep monitoring for 24h.

sre-oncall: moving to recovery: mark incident as mitigated for eu-west streaming stalls. We'll prepare a post-incident note and SLO impact calc. On-call handoff: I'll leave notes for morning oncall (@sre-oncall-morning) to verify continued stability at 12:30Z.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigated in eu-west-1. Root cause suspected: proxy keepalive + slow consumer interaction causing buffered sockets and stalled chunk delivery. Follow-ups assigned to infra-lead (proxy tuning + add metrics), eng-oncall (write-timeout safety tests), and product-manager (customer SLO communications).

sre-oncall: quick follow-ups: 1) add socket-age and write-backlog metrics to console, 2) run chaos test simulating slow consumers, 3) run load test with bursty fanout to replicate.

infra-lead: ack, I'll open RFC for improved proxy defaults and a migration plan.

eng-oncall: I'll add automated alert for socket backlog > 500 per node.

sre-oncall: thanks all. closing live channel now but keeping thread open for notes and the postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:
